name: Budhi Gandaki flood
headline: ~1 km landslide at Siringe Himal dammed the Ungilung stream; breach ~04:00 11 Oct.

sections.The setup: Wet end of monsoon: ~430 mm on 18–27 Sep, then 43 mm on 7–9 Oct (model data).
sections.The trigger: ~1 km landslide at Siringe Himal dammed the Ungilung stream; breach ~04:00 11 Oct.
sections.What amplified it: Saturated steep slopes in the 2015 earthquake region; unmonitored tributary.
sections.Climate signal: See Langtang: warming loads high slopes with rain and meltwater.
sections.Still open: Summary entry: the full deep-dive (day-by-day timeline, steering, how it ended, sources) has not been written yet. It will be added as the log works back through the year.
